name: Beavercreek
takeaway: Beavercreek runs its own aggregation with Constellation at 8.699¢/kWh, August 2025 through December 2026. Council passed Resolution 26-36 for a successor contract from January 2027, capped at 10.699¢. The executed price is not on file.
hook: Beavercreek's Constellation price of 8.699¢ runs out with the December 2026 meter read. The successor price can go as high as 10.699¢.
notes: AES Ohio territory, Greene County. City aggregation through Energy Alliances. Successor contract authorized by Res. 26-36 with a 10.699¢ cap; supplier and price after December 2026 not confirmed. Fairfield Commons and the I-675 corridor are the commercial concentration.

name: Huber Heights
takeaway: Huber Heights is a SOPEC member with AEP Energy as supplier. AEP Energy's page lists 8.951¢/kWh, 100% renewable, through the June 2026 meter read. SOPEC's city rate page shows no rate after that, marked coming soon. The price now in effect is not confirmed.
hook: Huber Heights' SOPEC price after June 2026 isn't posted yet. The last posted price was 8.951¢, and the AES Ohio standard offer is now 10.856¢.
notes: AES Ohio territory, Montgomery County. SOPEC member, supplier AEP Energy. Prior term 8.951¢ through June 2026 per AEP Energy (search summary, reliability 0.48). SOPEC city page shows $0.00, coming soon, as of 2026-11-23. Confirm the current rate with SOPEC at 1-888-733-8512. Warehouse and distribution presence along I-70.

name: Springfield
takeaway: Springfield in Clark County is a NOPEC electric member on the community map, the 2026 annual report, and the city's NOPEC resources page. The file price is the Ohio Edison standard, 10.399¢/kWh variable, from the September 2026 meter read through the June 2027 meter read, no exit fee. The city resources page does not restate that price.
hook: Springfield is on NOPEC electric. The file price is the Ohio Edison standard, 10.399¢ through June 2027. The city page does not restate the cents.
notes: Clark County seat. Community map: electric. 2026 annual report: electric roster. City NOPEC resources page: https://springfieldohio.gov/nopec-resources/. A 2018 city release names Ohio Edison as the distributor. File price left at the Ohio Edison standard. The resources page does not restate the September cents.
